content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The sources provide comprehensive details about the NPS Vatsalya Scheme, including: [E01] It is a contributory saving cum long-term financial security scheme designed exclusively for minors below 18 years of age to enhance financial literacy and financial planning. [E01] Parents or guardians can open accounts with a minimum contribution of ₹250 per year with no maximum limit, and relatives and friends can also gift contributions. [E01] Upon reaching 18 years, subscribers can continue for up to three years (till 21 years) unless they opt to exit. [E01] Partial withdrawals up to 25% of contributions (excluding returns) are allowed after 3 years for education, medical treatment, or disability exceeding 75%. [E02] The scheme is open to all Indian citizens under 18, including NRIs and OCIs. [E03] Key benefits include power of compounding, financial discipline, child empowerment, tax efficiency, market-linked returns, and 24/7 transparent online access. [E03] Accounts can be opened online through NPS Trust website or offline through registered Points of Presence (PoPs) such as banks and pension funds.
